name: morphing-button-group
title: Morphing Button Group
description: A row of buttons that morphs between sets: one button splits into two, two join into one, and a button that changes its label cross-fades it while it stretches. Ships with SignatureSheet, the pattern it was made for — a "Sign" pill that grows into a signing card whose Cancel splits into Reset + Confirm once you draw, and Confirm stretches into "Confirm Signature" before the card glides back down.
